Level 3 - Intermediate 30 min DevOps FinOps AWS

Cloud Cost and FinOps: Right-Sizing, Spot, Savings Plans

After this page you can read a cloud bill like a packet capture: see where the money goes, tag it to a team, shrink over-sized machines, put stateless pools on Spot, cover the steady base with Savings Plans or Reserved Instances, age old data into cheaper storage, delete forgotten resources, and stop paying for bytes that take the expensive route out of your VPC.
